brief.input: Synthetic recycled metal-rich core with a small binder, already contained. No material was processed.
brief.variation: Each prepared assembly is observed separately. No prediction of future batches.
brief.use_case: Noncritical software demonstration of mass and one-axis static balance.
brief.targets: Mass 980–1020 g; centre of mass x between -2 and 2 mm. Retention, durability and tipping safety need separate checks.
brief.process: Software only; no material handling or heating.
brief.available_changes: Add or remove sealed trim at two stated mass-centre locations; keep the core and product targets.

request.note:
Synthetic software observation bench-1, not a physical test. Complete assembly, including enclosure: 950 g; weighing uncertainty ±5 g. The same assembly has centre of mass x=+1.0 cm; centre uncertainty ±0.05 cm.
All coordinates share x=0 at the module centre, positive toward the right. The two location coordinates are the mass centres of the actual added or removed sealed trim, not hole centres.
Location L: x=-6 cm; position uncertainty ±0 mm; up to 150 g can be added and 0 g removed.
Location R: x=+60 mm; position uncertainty ±0 mm; up to 150 g can be added and 80 g removed.
Across both locations, the total addition limit is 150 g and total removable trim is 80 g.
The command increment is 1 g. The adjustment uncertainty is ±1 g independently at each active location.

expected.coordinate_basis: All coordinates share x=0 at the module centre, positive toward the right.
